fixer.title: chat: use the remote connections toggle for Mission Control

cases.mechanism: The initial Agent Host connection event queued a second full Mission Control configure operation behind the first, duplicating authentication lookup, workspace-root preparation, management IPC, filesystem realpath work, GitHub identity resolution, and environment registration on every enabled cold startup.
cases.symptom: Mission Control opt-in or restored startup performed two serialized registration passes, extending readiness and duplicating IPC, filesystem, and network work.
cases.fixedBehavior: The new sharing service ignores the Agent Host start event during the initial in-flight registration because _configured is false, then marks it configured only after configureMissionControl succeeds. A later real host restart still clears _configured and schedules exactly one replacement registration.
cases.evidence: In the base contribution, the initial _configure path called IAgentHostService.startAgentHost(), then awaited configureMissionControl over LocalAgentHostManagementConnection. That management channel cannot resolve until LocalAgentHostServiceClient reaches Connected; _handleConnectionState fires onAgentHostStart at that point. The base onAgentHostStart handler at line 100 unconditionally incremented the generation and scheduled another throttled _configure. Because the first _configure was active, Throttler retained one queued run; after the first IPC/network registration settled, that queued run repeated authentication.getSessions, workspace-root collection, startAgentHost, and configureMissionControl. The downstream MissionControlEnvironment registration resolves owner identity, realpaths roots, and performs GitHub registration/check-in network work. The PR's new line 106 gates the event on _configured, which remains false until the initial configureMissionControl has completed, while the added test still proves reconfiguration after a genuine later host restart.
